title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16228v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains

translated_title: 强化学习后印度语系任务的提升与退步
translated_abstract: 我们从涵盖英语和八种印度语言的监督微调30B-A3B混合专家（MoE）模型出发，使用GRPO在四个环境中进行强化学习（RL）训练。我们在一次评估活动中，跨34个基准测试比较了RL前后模型的表现。MATH提升了36.07分，大多数印度语言基准也有所提升。然而，随着英语回答比例从8.7%上升到91.7%，XQuAD-Indic的F1下降了19.32分；IndicQA下降8.64分，而英语XQuAD则提升了11.71 F1。第二次RL运行从相同的监督初始化开始，增加了一个印度语言环境以及语言和重复奖励。与已发布模型相比，它在段落问答和指令遵循基准上均有提升，同时保持了MATH性能，但在推理和编码基准上有所退步。由于多个训练选择同时改变，我们无法单独分离出任何一个奖励项的效果。书写文字遵从性仍然……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过GRPO强化学习显著提升了覆盖英语和八种印度语言的30B MoE模型的数学及多数印度语言任务表现，但发现英语回答倾向增强导致跨语言问答大幅退化，且加入语言奖励的第二次RL训练虽改善了指令遵循，却以牺牲推理和编码能力为代价。
en_tdlr: RL with GRPO improves MATH and most Indic benchmarks for a 30B-A3B MoE model, but rising English-answer leakage causes large XQuAD-Indic and IndicQA regressions, and a second RL run adding language and repetition rewards gains passage-answering and instruction-following at the cost of reasoning and coding performance.
